payload.core_mechanism_summary: DP over positions in s and t (2D state) to maximize total length of k common substrings, using precomputed longest common suffix lengths.
payload.rationale: The solution computes a 2D table of longest common suffix lengths, then iteratively performs DP over k, updating a 2D table f[i][j] to represent the best total length using current number of segments ending at or before positions i,j.
